snippet.title: Segata Sanshiro Shinken Yugi [Saturn] by Ecole Software [HD] [1080p]
snippet.description:
Segata Sanshiro Shinken Yugi (せがた三四郎 真剣遊戯) is a 1998 Sega Saturn title starring the system's iconic mascot, martial arts master, and seemingly superhuman badass, Segata Sanshiro. It features a diverse and fairly challenging assortment of minigames spanning multiple genres. As each game is cleared, the commercial upon which it was based is unlocked and made available in the gallery. Truly a worthwhile collection for any Saturn die-hard.

FUN FACT: While development of the game is never explicitly credited to any one company or subsidary, the file 0000SAN does mention Ecole Software, making them the most likely culprit. I'm not surprised this wasn't publicized. After all, Ecole was responsible for the notorious Death Crimson just two years earlier.
